messages.author: 28594465dfd63f8f
messages.subject: Legend with stat_summary
parts:
Hello everybody,

I'm a beginner in ggplot 2, and I try to add a stat_summary to a graph
with already 2 curves (geom_line). A legend is created for these 2
curves. I created the mean curve easily (with a stat_summary), but
when I try to add the mean in the legend, it doesn't appear...

Here is the code snippet which enables to do that :

g = ggplot(dat,aes(x=jour,y=valeur))
g+geom_line(aes(col=annee),position="dodge") + stat_summary
(fun.y=mean,colour="black", geom="line", size = 0.8)


Sorry if my question seems ridiculous, but the way legend are created
is not very clear in my mind for the moment...

Thank you in advance.

messages.subject: Re: Legend with stat_summary
parts:
Hi Hadley and sorry to answer so late...
I tried to reproduce my problem with a built-in dataset but I could
not. So I created a snippet wich reproduces it :

year = as.factor( c(rep(2005, 365), rep(2006, 365) ))
day = c(1:365, 1:365 )
val = c(1:365, 365:1 )
tab = data.frame(year,day,val)

g <- ggplot(tab,aes(x=day,y=val))
g <- g + geom_point(aes(col=year),position="dodge")
g <- g + stat_summary(fun.y=mean,col="black", geom="line", size =
0.8 ) # (2)
print(g)

I tried to add an aesthetic on line (2) but the main legend (with year-
color legend) is modified instead of adding a new one with mean
legend.

Thank you in advance.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Legend with stat_summary
parts:
Hi Sebastian,

The ggplot2 way would be to do something like:

g <- ggplot(tab,aes(x=day,y=val))
g <- g + geom_point(aes(col=year),position="dodge")
g <- g + stat_summary(aes(colour = "mean"), fun.y=mean, geom="line", size =

0.8 ) # (2)
print(g)

and then use a custom scale to get the desired colours.

Hadley
